I've saved it to memory and replied to Tobias in their DM. Your standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team for the Elmstead rollout is Mondays at 8:45 from now on.

It's stored as Tobias's own note. Since you told me in a direct message, I'll only bring it up when I'm talking with you. There's already a note about another member's standing call with Marrow, but I kept the two separate, and I haven't mentioned it to you.

I didn't put anything on the calendar because you said no action was needed. You also didn't say am or pm, so I saved the time as "8:45" as you wrote it.
